title: Zero-safe unsigned division and remainder
summary: Executes the compiler's zero-divisor branch and ordinary unsigned division or remainder for staged operands, preserving the store and stack tail.
premises: Exact equality with the emitted checked division or remainder region
A Boolean selecting remainder or division
Combined getters for both staged UInt64 operands
A continuation for the selected UInt64 result
result: The program pushes left % right or left / right, implements their Lean zero-divisor values without a WASM arithmetic trap, and preserves the store and other frame fields.
